summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM and advanced-packaging sub-supplier node using an underfollowed discovery lens. The strongest discovery candidates are not the obvious HBM producers or mega-cap foundry/equipment leaders, but specialty inspection, metrology, probe-card/test, and bonding-equipment vendors that sit one or two layers beneath AI accelerators and HBM capacity. The best-supported candidates in this pass are Camtek, Onto Innovation, FormFactor, and Kulicke & Soffa. Claims are intentionally conservative: direct HBM order/customer evidence is strongest for Camtek; Onto and FormFactor have plausible advanced-packaging/HBM test exposure but need segment-level verification; Kulicke & Soffa is a more speculative challenger in thermo-compression/hybrid-bonding-related advanced packaging.
